system.description: You carry a hunting-writ under the wick-and-flame seal of the Candle-Wicked Men. Within Emberglow, you have Boon on tests to demand entry, search a house or take a suspect into custody, and the Wickguard will not hinder you. The Order may send you a name at any hour. If you refuse it or fail it, the writ burns in your coat, and the Order remembers your face.
